resort_official.report_text:
November 24, 2026 | 7:58 AM

Partly sunny skies are in the forecast today, with a high near 38°F. Southwest winds will be around 5 mph, with gusts up to 20 mph.

11 lifts are scheduled to operate from 9 AM–4 PM, serving 76 open trails across the mountain.

Today’s Mountain Tip: Head over to Belmont Park, where the park crew has been hard at work getting the best park in Tahoe dialed. Belmont currently has 30 features, ranging from small jumps and boxes to more technical kink rails, creating a true skatepark-style feel on snow.

See you out there!

-Dom

* Patchy freezing fog in some eastern CA valleys diminishes by later this morning, then winds increase mainly for ridge tops this afternoon through early Wednesday morning.

* Dry conditions are now expected for the peak travel period prior to Thanksgiving, except for a few light rain and snow showers in northeast CA late tonight into early Wednesday morning.

* Dry and mild weather is favored for much of the Thanksgiving holiday weekend, but a more active storm pattern may return from the late weekend into early December.
